notes.title: V1.34 Patch Notes (7/11/2025)
notes.notes:
Surprise update today! This is just a big ol' bunch of bug fixes with the only real addition being a new common perk that I think you will like! 

Apologies for going off schedule. I previously said that the next update you'd see would be V1.4 sometime in late summer. After the release of V1.33 (autosave update), there were some really annoying bugs that I wanted to fix before a rather long period of no updates. This build is a lot more stable than V1.33, I hope you'll enjoy the fixes I made here. As always, you can find the full list of changes below.

Bug fixes:
==========
-Fixed the bug where setting up a chain of multiple squids to transform into a "first peg popped" item would result in most of the squids in the chain having their effect skipped. (AKA the "lazy squids bug")
-Added a failsafe for save data corruption. If you've experienced a crash where the game crashes immediately once it launches, that's due to a save file being corrupted and the game trying to read the save data but failing. This isn't a solution to save corruption, but it does fix the immediate crash, thus preventing the game from becoming unplayable.
-Fixed round 900 crash in endless mode
-Fixed issue with crashing in endless after receiving a perk
-Fixed issue in endless where you could come across final bosses again.
-Warlock perk description updated
-You can no longer use the load button to access endless mode in challenges
-Pause button in upper right corner of screen now appears in endless mode
-End game button now appears when loading into an endless mode save
-Alien now appears in nubby mart (like all the other black market items) while playing as criminal tony
-Non-upgraded inflatable dolphin beach ball summon is now counted as a summon.
-House'O'Cards perk now triggers "20 pegs popped" items.
-House'O'Cards perk now triggers "12 pegs popped" items.
-House'O'Cards perk now triggers items with "x pegs popped" triggers as their second trigger while playing on mutant tony.
-Crazy straw can now be obtained while playing as C.E.O. Tony
-Dave and Lentil food effect outcomes are now affected by game seed.
-Fixed bug where if you spammed the "exit" button on the claw machine you could break it and cause the claw machine to stay on screen for the next round.
-Fixed bug where insulation would give points even if it didn't hit a peg.
-Fixed the crash caused by eating the chip item in the cafe and then grabbing another food item while the chip was being consumed. 
-Fixed odds issue with flaming skull item: odds changed from 1/11 to 1/10, as was originally intended.
-Fixed the unnecessary extra gap in the item description of squid while playing as mutant tony.
-Fixed bug where 1Q+ pegs were valued at 0.
-Broken socket can now be triggered by other broken sockets.
-Broken Socket now triggers twice on glass tony


Additions:
==========
-Added common perk: "Archaic Perk" - Every 1.5 seconds -> Force-triggers all non-upgraded items.
	-This perk does not appear in the "Times Up!" challenge.


Other changes:
==========
-Starting with this update, existing autosaves will be deleted when you update the game due to incompatibility in saved data.

notes.title: Nubby Patch V1.32 (The Autosave Patch)
notes.notes:
Hello! Welcome to the long awaited V1.32! I'm happy to get this out to the public so I can begin work on some really fun stuff. Either way, enjoy autosaving! 

V1.3.2 Patch Notes:
==========


Bug fixes:
==========
-Fixed bug where egg missiles from rubber chicken didn't collide with pegs on hunter tony

-Kebab perk and croissant perk now have their triggers randomized in bologna tony

-Fixed the peg revival glitch with cactus and uranium rod (shoutout to Seymour for the help)

-Game no longer crashes are round 467 (thanks again, Seymour)

-Fixed the bug where if you spammed the launch nubby button right at the start of the game, you'd get a 9999x restock.

-Fixed bug where you could steal corrupted items as criminal tony and end up with negative money as a result

-Asbestos insulation summons now count as summons





Additions:
=========
-Implemented autosave system (yippee)




Other Changes:
==========

-For lunar perk: the amount of force triggers is now determined by the round number instead of how many rounds it has been in your inventory

-Warlock perk now triggers all "Nubby Dies ->" items.

-Asbestos insulation now gives 5%-10% of the round goal. Upgraded asbestos gives between 12%-17% of the round goal (sad, but we all knew this was coming)

-Broken socket now triggers on: "item to the right of me triggers"; Has a 25% chance to execute its cluster shock effect.
	-Same thing for upgraded broken socket.

-Coin sound effect is less shrill

-In the in-game pause menu, "Abandon Game" button is replaced by "Save and Quit" button.

-For "Pol's Bane" challenge: T-Block, E-Block, and Flibby Flobbies are no longer obtainable.

-For "Time's Up!" challenge: Cheesy Perk is no longer obtainable.

-All-seeing pyramid item no longer appears in the early game and has the same item weight as T-Block.

-Avocado price changed from 11 to 9.
-Evil goose priced changed from 6 to 5.
-Flamethrower price changed from 9 to 7.

notes.title: Hotfix V1.3.1.5 Patch Notes (5/26/2025)
notes.notes:
V1.3.1.5 Hotfix Notes:
==========

Welcome to V1.3.1.5! This is a surprise patch that I wanted to sneak into the current update schedule. The goal of this patch is mainly to fix bugs.

The next patch will implement autosaves. That will be the last patch before V1.4 (which is going to be a big update that adds a lot of stuff.)


Bug fixes:
==========
	-Abolished max restock tax
	-The croissant perk now actually does what the description says.
	-Fixed crashes with minds eye on amnesiac challenge
	-Fixed bug where playing as glass tony and then playing as another supervisor would set lives to 2 
at the start of the game.
	-Fixed more technical issues with force-ending the round.
	-Fixed item drag and drop sound fx
	-Fixed charity perk and drainer perk crash when googol is reached.
	-Actually fixed the squid duping bug this time.
	-Added closed and half-open animation frames to the mind's eye toggle button (purely cosmetic)
	
Additions:
==========	
	-Added "Moldy Sandwich" item (common, food).
		-This item is exclusive to balogna tony.

Balance Changes:
==========

	-Buffed alien (changed trigger to "2 pegs doubled ->")

notes.title: Nubby's Number Factory V1.3.1 (large patch)
notes.notes:
Welcome to Nubby's Number Factory V1.3.1. This has been a long while coming, and I'm happy to be rolling out Nubby updates again. This isn't the biggest update you'll ever see for the game and it mostly fixes bugs and adds quality of life things. This is the first of two patches coming before the heavily anticipated V1.4 update, which will be probably the biggest update the game will get. Enjoy!



V1.3.1 Patch Notes:

Bug fixes:
=====

-Fixed some suffix naming issues with huge numbers
-Fixed visual bug where the countdown indicator over items appeared above error messages
-Strawberry works in amnesiac now
-Volume of Ouroboros noise now corresponds to sfx volume setting.
-Volume of alternative Evil Goose+ noise now corresponds to sfx volume setting.
-Setting "press button" keybinding to mouse side button 1 or 2 no longer soft locks game.
-Starfruit can no longer be found in  "Stay There!" challenge. Not even from fava bean.
-Fixed but where you could still launch nubby / jumble pegs in the lock/key portion of the black market sequence
-Fixed the frame-perfect bug where you could skip special events and boss events by firing nubby before the prompt appears
-Fixed squid duplicating issue.
-Fixed bug where picking items from the black market while playing on criminal tony charges you money. That was unintentional.
-Fixed Jake The Snake+ issue where if he tries to double all pegs twice, it only doubles one peg, twice. It actually doubles all pegs twice now!

Minor changes:
=====
-When eating foods that give perks (croissant,kebab,donut), a perk will appear that floats into your inventory, similar to how it works with loot (this is just for visuals).
-Fishman+ now triggers the most recently obtained perk twice, instead of the two most recently obtained perks once.
-Donut, and Fishman now say what the most recently obtained perk is in their item descriptions.
-In the "Times Up!" challenge, the monstrosity item is replaced by "rabid monstrosity".
	-Rabid monstrosity summons 3 meat orbs on first peg popped; rabid monstrosity+ summons 3 disease orbs on first peg popped.
-Added "First peg popped ->" and "Nubby dies ->" triggers as possible outcomes for bologna tony random item triggers.
-Game seed is now displayed in the bottom right corner during the game.
-If you have more than 1x jumble from eating starfruit, the amount of jumbles you have remaining is displayed on the jumble button.
-Revamped E-Block sprite because I lost the blender project file for it womp womp

Semi-Major changes:
=====
-Implemented "mind's eye" mode which allows you to view some useful stats related to the ongoing / previous turn.
	-Also highlights the highest peg on the pegboard when you're aiming nubby. This doesn't work on round 1 or the tutorial
	-Toggle this on/off by pressing the button in the top left of the factory during a game.
	-For reference, this feature was originally called "assist mode" in the WNN steam page posts.

Re-balances / reworks:
=====

-Changed nubbys physics (compromise between v1.3 and v1.4)
-Slightly changed trophy perk to prevent infinite loops early game with poopbutt and others
-Buffed alien trigger
-Decreased how often dupe mystery boxes show up for amnesiac (1 in 10 chance)
-Completely reworked croissant perk
-Reworked glass tony effect: "Maximum lives capped at 2. When an item triggers, it triggers twice. Perks are unaffected."
-Buffed seal, slaps more pegs now.
	-Also buffed mutant tony trigger (2 seconds to 1 second)
-Rubber chicken's mutant tony trigger changed to "3 pegs halved ->"
-Buffed raygun perk: 40% chance to trigger instead of 25% chance.

Content additions:
=====
-Added new food item: Soup crackers (rare)
-Added new item: T-Block (common)
-Added new black market item: Flibby Flobbies (rare)
-Added voice overs to all supervisors in the supervisor selection menu

notes.title: V1.3.1 First-day-after-update patch!

These are not all the changes that need to be made, but I wanted to fix some big ones and non-time-consuming ones quickly so you can enjoy the update sooner. I will be putting out more patches in the days to come to address some more balance concerns. THANKS FOR NUBBIN' IT UP TONYSTYLE DAWWG!

notes.title: NNF V1.3 Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300425/2a29a7c8d818ca0466efd3965e729ccea8137773.jpg





Welcome to version 1.3 of Nubby's Number Factory - "The Everyman's Update"

This update is called "The Everyman's Update" because it fixes, tweaks, and adds things all across the board! There are multiple focus points of this update.

The main focuses of this update are as follows:

-To add content to parts of the game that are lacking in variety,
-To rework some challenges to reduce frustration and improve fairness
-To rework the supervisor unlock system
-To adjust endless mode scaling
-To fix bugs, crashes, imbalances, etc.


*Below is the full changelog. The points stated above are basically the TL:DR.




NNF V1.3 Changelog:
========


======
Minor tweaks:
======
-Fixed bug where "first peg popped ->" items won't activate when the first peg is popped in a round after the previous round is force-ended via the red button.
-Trophy perk will not proc if its odds dont hit (similar to how springy perk does - just so it doesn't take so much time)
-Adjusted Jake the Snake+ sound fx volume
-Fixed bug where "nubby dies ->" perks trigger after clicking the force end button
-Fixed crash with abort button in pause menu
-Fixed the softlock bug where if you've had more than 1 black market key, the second black market you opened wouldn't let you proceed.
-Fixed bug where pausing the game in claw machine / nubby mart / black market / cafe nubby makes it so you can jumble and aim during the shop.
-Fixed plain jane crash when opening loot.
-Skip button in open-capsule sequence is now push and hold.
-Evil goose now actually gives double the points of lowest # peg, like it was originally supposed to.
-Buffed Evil goose+ (4x # of lowest peg instead of 3x)
-When a laser pointer electron-beam / hyper-beam hits a negative peg from the "pessimism" boss, it will give a negative amount of points.
-Added new sfx to pause menu / settings
-Sea cucumber costs 1 less coin
-Added a push-and-hold "End Game" button to endless mode. It causes a game over when activated.
-Fixed ton of feathers crash (maybe)
-The "Dave" food item is now free.
-Added counters to UI that display how many peg pops, doubles, and halves occurred in a round.
-Slight nerf to claymanguy and claymanguy+ - summons 2 clay balls instead of 3
-Reworked mollusk effect
-Buffed wingless fly
-Claymanguy now triggers every half second instead of on 12 pegs popped
-Reworked trophy perk effect - it requires nubby to be alive to trigger now.
-Moved trophy perk out of rare
-Buffed drainer perk. It now drains 3% total points instead of 5%
-Fixed bug where if you paused on loot screen, you could launch nubby after unpausing and softlock the game 
-Kebab costs 10 coins instead of 9 now.
-Lentil re-sprited
-Laser-pointer now triggers on "2 pegs halved ->" instead of "2 pegs doubled ->"
-Blood rains spawns 30% faster in the "apocalypse" final boss
-Tony shoots lasers 50% faster in in the "tony!??!" final boss
-Buffed "Speedy Perk". Will trigger if round started less than 1.5 seconds ago, rather than 1 second ago.
-Reworked croissant: Croissant now gives a croissant perk when eaten.
-Slight nubby physics change. Less random angle offset when hitting a peg. Maximum is 1 degree is a negative or positive direction.
-Completely reworked charity perk.... I'll let you guys be the judge of the new charity perk..
-Buffed jake the snake odds, but made him a corrupted black market item (common)
-You can now see what round you died on during gameover
-Made pregnancy test rare (queue sad violin)
-Buffed broken socket, and increased its price by 2 coins. (Now triggers on "Pass round goal")
-Flaming skull is now a common item.
-Minor UX touch ups to challenges screen
-Rearranged challenge order in challenge screen to roughly align with the generally agreed upon difficulty of the challenges.
-Fixed bug where the backers of corrupted items covered up the corrupted item in nubby mart after returning from cafe nubby when playing on criminal tony.
-Burglar peg now sells the item in slot #2 instead of slot #1, so that there is no conflict with mystery box perk
-Rebalanced pricing and max coins from strawberry (7 max)

======
Major changes:
======
Reworks to board clears:
	-Getting a board clear ends the round and clears all item/perk activation queues.
		-Same for if you cleared the board, but didn't beat the round goal.
	-You now get a 2X bonus to your total points instead of +5 coins.
	-Whether you passed the round goal or not, getting a board clear will always double points.
-Endless mode round goals now scale exponentially.
-You can now adjust particle levels in advanced settings
-You can now disable item/perk sound fx in advanced settings
-You can now choose to enter the black market OR save your key and go to nubby mart instead.
-Implemented zone-specific theme songs (2 for each) (HUGE SHOUTOUT TO VINEGART. HE NAILED IT!)
	-Sound track is coming very soon, all proceeds from soundtrack go directly to Vinegart. Show the man some love.
-You can now press and hold "R" during a game to quickly restart.
-You can resize the game window now.
-Challenges no longer unlock supervisors. Instead, they're purchased with stars.
	-Stars are a currency. They are obtained by doing well in-game.
	-In a game, 1 star is granted per boss round defeated in that game. For example, a game over on round 65 would grant 3 stars.
		-The exception: winning a non-challenge game grants 5 stars, and beating any challenge grants 10 stars.
	-If you already have supervisors unlocked from beating challenges, they will still be unlocked for you.





=====
New (or reworked) items:
=====

-"Toy Fish" (black market, common) 
-"Pointer" (black market, common)
-"Happy seal" (nubby-mart, common)
-"Two-headed" turtle (nubby-mart, common)
-"Ouroboros" (black market, common)
-"Poop Butt" (nubby-mart, common)
-"Alien" (black market, common)
-"E-Block" (nubby-mart, common)
-"Chip" (cafe nubby, common)
-"Fava bean" (cafe nubby, rare)
-"Avocado" (cafe nubby, rare)
-"Starfruit" (cafe nubby, ultra-rare)

-Reworked Crazy Straw 
-Reworked Croissant 
-Reworked Mollusk




=====
New (or reworked) perks:
=====

-"Tornado perk" (rare)
-"Warlock perk" (common)
-"Gourmet perk" (common)
-"Lunar perk" (common)
-"Croissant perk" (common, obtained from croissant)

-Reworked charity perk






=====
Changes to challenges:
=====

"Expiration Date":
	-Items last 15 rounds instead of 10
	-Added alarm sound effect for "Expiration Date" when an item has 1 round remaining

"Nubbelocke":
	-Instead of deleting a random item, deletes the left-most item

"Times up!":
	-When nubby explodes by the hands of the C-4, it causes a big explosion that pops a large radius of pegs

"Amnesiac":
	-There are now 4 types of mystery boxes
		-Common item mystery box: Contains a random common item
		-Duplicate item mystery box: Contains a copy of an item in your inventory
		-Rare item mystery box: Contains a random rare item.
		-Ultra rare item mystery box: Contains an ultra-rare item.
	-Each type of mystery box has a unique color, name, and description, so you can tell them apart.
	-Common mystery boxes cost 4 coins.
	-Duplicate mystery boxes cost 6 coins.
	-Rare and ultra-rare mystery boxes cost 6 coins.

=====
Changes to supervisors:
=====

Balogna Tony:
	-No longer randomizes Nubby's size, physics, etc.
	-No longer randomizes the round timeline
	-Primary effect is that he randomizes item and perk triggers at the start of a run.



=====
Things that didn't make it into this version:
=====
-The stat tracker didn't quite make it into this version because it wasn't very comprehensive and I didn't want to put something incomplete into the game.
-Grouping together similar perks didn't make it into this version either for a similar reason as above. Next update, I promise!

======

ENJOY THE UPDATE! 
Live. Laugh. Nub.

notes.title: Update V1.2 - Mostly initial bug fixes
notes.notes:
Welcome to version 1.2 of Nubby's Number Factory! This update is not a content update. This update was put out to fix some especially prevalent bugs that cause some annoying crashes. Thank you for your patience in this first week!


NNF V1.2 Changelog:
========

	Minor changes:
	======
	-Fixed some crashes with "Pol's Bane" challenge and "Plain Jane" challenge
	-Picklerat can no longer be found in "Stay There!" challenge
	-Croissant can no longer be found in "One Shot McGee" challenge
	-Patched crash with "All-Seeing Pyramid" item
	-Changed difficulty rating for a few challenges
	-Nerfed plastic tree+ effect
	-Nerfed trigger of plastic tree and its upgrade
	-Slight buff to horse pill and its upgrade
	-Springy perk only procs when its guaranteed to hit the 5% odds
	-Laser pointer moved to rare
	-Fixed lentil crashes
	-Limited how many nubbys can exist on screen at a time for pregnancy test (256)
	-Nerfed kebab perk
	-Flutty+ buff
	-Fixed the super cheesy supervisor unlock bug (thanks gab)

	Major changes:
	======
	-You can now force-end the round if you're experiencing a softlock.
	-Difficulty ratings unimplemented from challenges
